summary: Eight games were played on Monday, and road teams won four of them. New Orleans opened with a 21-0 run and beat Golden State by 21, the night's widest margin, while Memphis scored a night-high 136 after outscoring Washington 42-18 in the third quarter. Donovan Mitchell had the night's top scoring game with 39 points in Cleveland's win over Chicago, and Joel Embiid scored 37 as Philadelphia won in Brooklyn.

games.headline: Magic pull away late to win in Boston
games.story: Orlando led 50-41 at halftime, but Boston outscored the Magic 36-25 in the third quarter to lead 77-75 going into the fourth. A 9-0 Orlando run put the Magic ahead for good at 85-82, and they led by as many as 11 in the final two minutes while winning the fourth 40-28. Desmond Bane scored 24 points, Franz Wagner had 21 points, eight rebounds and nine assists, and Anthony Black added 20. Jayson Tatum had 24 points and 12 rebounds for Boston, and Orlando was without Paolo Banchero and Jonathan Isaac.

games.headline: Mitchell scores 39 as Cavaliers beat Bulls
games.story: Chicago led 31-25 after the first quarter and by as many as eight early in the second, but Cleveland went ahead for good at 41-40 and outscored the Bulls 32-17 in the quarter to lead 57-48 at halftime. The Cavaliers stretched the lead to 17 early in the third, and Chicago answered with 10 straight points to get within seven. Donovan Mitchell scored 39 points on 16-of-25 shooting, Jarrett Allen had 13 points and 14 rebounds, and James Harden added 10 assists. Norman Powell scored 27 and Matas Buzelis 23 for Chicago, while Cleveland was without Evan Mobley, Sam Merrill and Jaylon Tyson.

games.headline: Boozer's 29 lift Grizzlies past Wizards
games.story: Washington led 69-59 at halftime, but Memphis used a 10-0 run early in the third quarter to tie the game at 73. The Grizzlies went ahead for good at 81-79, outscored the Wizards 42-18 in the quarter and led by as many as 22 late in the fourth. Cameron Boozer scored 29 points with seven 3-pointers, Zach Edey had 23 points and 10 rebounds, and Javon Small added 12 points and 12 assists. Anthony Davis scored 23, AJ Dybantsa 21 and Trae Young had 12 assists for Washington.

games.headline: Embiid scores 37 as 76ers hold off Nets
games.story: Philadelphia scored 45 points in the second quarter and led 78-59 at halftime after building a 24-point lead. Brooklyn got within four at 125-121 with 1:14 left, but the 76ers closed the game on a 10-2 run. Joel Embiid scored 37 points on 13-of-22 shooting, Jaylen Brown had 31 points and 13 rebounds, and Tyrese Maxey added 24 points and nine assists. Julius Randle scored 33 and Michael Porter Jr. 25 for Brooklyn, while LeBron James did not play for Philadelphia.

games.headline: Heat lead wire to wire in win over Rockets
games.story: Miami scored the first basket, never trailed and led 29-15 after the first quarter. The Heat were ahead 62-46 at halftime and built their biggest lead at 126-100 late in the fourth. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 20 points, 13 rebounds and six assists on 8-of-11 shooting, Davion Mitchell added 16 points and 10 assists, and Klay Thompson made five 3-pointers for 17 points. Alperen Sengun scored 23 and Kevin Durant 22 for Houston, which did not play Amen Thompson, Marcus Smart or Steven Adams.

games.headline: Shannon scores 34 as Timberwolves top Blazers
games.story: Portland scored 12 straight points early to lead 12-2, but the game was tied 26-26 after the first quarter. Minnesota went ahead for good at 46-45 during a 10-0 run in the second quarter, led 87-73 after three and by as many as 20 in the fourth. Terrence Shannon Jr. scored 34 points on 8-of-11 shooting and 15-of-16 free throws, and Rudy Gobert had 18 points and 15 rebounds. Deni Avdija scored 27 for Portland and Donovan Clingan blocked five shots, while Minnesota was without Anthony Edwards and Portland was without Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe.

games.headline: Pelicans open with 21-0 run, rout Warriors
games.story: After a 2-2 start, New Orleans scored 21 straight points and led 35-11 after the first quarter. The Pelicans led 61-36 at halftime and by as many as 31 in the third quarter. Saddiq Bey scored 23 points with five 3-pointers, Jeremiah Fears had a triple-double with 19 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists, and Derik Queen added 17 points and 10 rebounds. Yaxel Lendeborg scored 28 for Golden State, which was without Stephen Curry, Jimmy Butler III and Kristaps Porzingis.

games.headline: Suns pull away from Nuggets in second half
games.story: Denver led 24-20 after the first quarter, and Phoenix was ahead 56-53 at halftime in a game that was tied 14 times. The Suns went ahead for good at 66-64 in the third quarter, used a 9-0 run late in the quarter to lead 90-77 and were ahead by as many as 19 in the fourth. Devin Booker scored 20 points with eight assists, and Miles Bridges and Jalen Green each added 16. Nikola Jokić had 28 points, 15 rebounds and seven assists, and Jamal Murray also scored 28 for Denver.
